faq.title: System FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common questions about the AmaImagery studio architecture.
faq.a1: By anchoring generations to precise seeds and metadata, the system allows for pixel-perfect reproduction of previous results.
faq.q2: Can I customize the interface density?
faq.a2: Yes. The system supports multiple visual modes, from 'Editorial' for clean focus to 'Dashboard' for data-heavy workflows.
faq.a3: AmaImagery is built with privacy-first principles. Your prompts and history are yours alone, stored in a secure, isolated environment.
